name: project-setup
description: Project setup in two steps: /project-start makes a repo and a folder to drop brand materials into, /project-create builds the prototyping project from them — one platform per project, designer-friendly docs, a canonical DESIGN.md (identity) and IMPLEMENT.web.md (web behaviour), and a populated Figma design library. /sync-tokens regenerates everything derived from the two files. Generated projects are agent-agnostic (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI first-class).
